C1185.title: Apifox Desktop Client Hit by Supply Chain Poisoning Attack
C1185.summary: Between March 4 and March 22, 2026, the cross-platform desktop client of the API debugging tool Apifox was targeted in a supply chain poisoning attack. Attackers tampered with a dynamic script file on Apifox's official CDN to implant a covert backdoor.
